name: SD Muhammadiyah Condongcatur

notes.id: Uang pangkal = biaya pembangunan. Amal jariyah tiga pilihan: Rp4,5 juta, Rp5 juta, Rp5,5 juta.
notes.en: Entry fee = building fee. Voluntary donation in three tiers: Rp4.5, 5 or 5.5 million.

source.title: Harga SD Swasta Terbaik di Yogyakarta (Data Pendidikan)

notes.id: Uang pangkal di sini = uang pangkal dll + annual fee (sesuai sumber). SPP termasuk katering dan snack. Ekskul Rp150–350 ribu.
notes.en: Entry fee here = entry fee etc. + annual fee (as given by the source). Tuition includes catering and snacks. Extracurriculars Rp150–350k.

source.title: Biaya Pendidikan 18 SD Islam Favorit di Yogyakarta (blog Pratiwanggini)
